name: Marketing Swarm Template
headline: Marketing Swarm Template - AI-Powered Content
short_description: The Marketing Swarm Template is a framework for creating multi-platform marketing content using AI agents. It enables marketers to generate and manage content across various platforms efficiently. The template connects to AI agents like Claude and integrates with marketing workflows to streamline content creation.
author: The-Swarm-Corporation

sections.overview:
The Marketing Swarm Template is a framework built on the Swarms platform for creating marketing content across 10+ channels including Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Email, and Twitter using AI agents. It implements Alex Hormozi's high-ticket offer frameworks to generate platform-specific content strategies automatically. Users configure company information and pain points via environment variables, then run agents that produce carousel posts, reels, LinkedIn thought leadership, email sequences, and Twitter threads tailored to their target audience. The template handles template-based customization and provides specialized agents for each platform's unique content requirements. Marketers benefit from automated, value-first content generation without manually writing for each channel.
Generate carousel posts, story sequences, and reel scripts for Instagram marketing
Create LinkedIn thought leadership posts and B2B case study content
Produce TikTok viral content with hooks and pattern interrupts
Build email welcome sequences, nurture campaigns, and sales funnels
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/The-Swarm-Corporation/Marketing-Swarm-Template`
sections.usage:
```
Create a marketing swarm template for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. The template should include content for [PLATFORMS] and be optimized for [TARGET_AUDIENCE]. Ensure the content is engaging, consistent, and tailored to each platform's best practices. Use [DATA] to inform the content strategy and tone of voice.
```
